summary.result: In 2016, an operational system was established in a rural catchment (1,500 k㎡) in the Seomjin river basin.
summary.background: The purpose of the farmstead-specific early warning service system for weather risk management is to develop custom-made risk management recommendations for individual farms threatened by climate change and its variability.
summary.method: Currently, the technology necessary to make the warning system more practical has been developed, including technology for forecasting real-time weather conditions, scaling down of weather data to the individual farm level and risk assessments of specific crops.
